description: K₂NaNbO₂F₄ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded to four O and eight F atoms to form KO₄F₈ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve KO₄F₈ cuboctahedra, faces with six KO₄F₈ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₂F₄ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent NbO₂F₄ octahedra. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 3.01-3.07 Å. There are a spread of K-F bond distances ranging from 3.00-3.07 Å. In the second K site, K is bonded to four O and eight F atoms to form KO₄F₈ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve KO₄F₈ cuboctahedra, faces with six KO₄F₈ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₂F₄ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent NbO₂F₄ octahedra. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 3.01-3.11 Å. There are a spread of K-F bond distances ranging from 3.01-3.11 Å. Na is bonded to two O and four F atoms to form NaO₂F₄ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NbO₂F₄ octahedra and faces with eight KO₄F₈ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-3°. Both Na-O bond lengths are 2.40 Å. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.29 Å. Nb is bonded to two O and four F atoms to form NbO₂F₄ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₂F₄ octahedra and faces with eight KO₄F₈ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-3°. Both Nb-O bond lengths are 1.90 Å. There are a spread of Nb-F bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.04 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to four K, one Na, and one Nb atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to four K, one Na, and one Nb atom. There are four inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four K, one Na, and one Nb atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four equivalent K, one Na, and one Nb atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four equivalent K, one Na, and one Nb atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four K, one Na, and one Nb atom.
